Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Outfit: a burnt-orange dance-rehearsal set with a sculpted sweetheart crop top held by two wide looped fabric shoulder straps, paired with high-waisted, petal-overlap stretch culotte shorts and soft ivory ankle warmers. The crop top has an angular cutout below the sternum; bust and pelvis have opaque lining. No armor or regalia.
POSTURE: sitting on the ground.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand cups her chin, that elbow resting on her raised knee, her elbow on her knee.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is planted on the ground beside her.
LEGS: one knee drawn up, the other leg resting flat.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: level lowered brow, steady unblinking eyes, mouth closed in a straight line, jaw set.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements; by position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
